label: ATA 191 2-port analog telephone adapter
description: Two-port handset-to-Ethernet adapter with 2 RJ-11 FXS ports, each an independent SIP registration, and one 10/100BASE-T RJ-45 network port.
notes: Datasheet hardware: two RJ-11 FXS ports, one 10/100 Mbps RJ-45 Ethernet port; admin guide calls it an RJ-45 10/100BASE-T WAN port with autonegotiation, no gigabit. Each FXS port has its own MAC address but is analog telephony, so it is not modelled. SLIC drives 3 REN ring load, 40-90 Vpk ring voltage. IPv4 only on the 191 (the 192 adds IPv6). 802.1p/Q, DiffServ, CDP, LLDP, SNTP, 5 VDC power (no PoE).
